title: Chrome Needs Twice-a-Week Patching Thanks to AI Bug Hunting
summary: In a report published Thursday , the Chrome security team says the browser's two major version releases in June included fixes for 1,072 security bugs—more patches than the team shipped in the prior 23 big releases combined.
